documentation: To add or change a consequential public claim: update the canonical claims registry first, then add the route to allowedRoutes, add or revise a uses entry with the rendered wording and approved maturity, and run npm run content:validate. Never use do_not_publish maturity.

uses.wording: The Physical Operations Platform
Last Mile Platform
Last Mile connects the missing accountability chain without replacing the systems that already run the plant.
Existing OT, data, work, facilities, and service platforms retain their identities and responsibilities.
One accountable operating condition—from first evidence to verified physical outcome.
One accountable operating condition—from first evidence to verified outcome.
Work complete is not the same as recovery established.
The work order can close before the operating condition is recovered.
Work completion starts the measurement window.
No valid data cannot support a recovered result.
SAP work closure starts verification; current valid cooling measurements establish physical recovery.
Three complete drawdown cycles and current valid station measurements establish restored pumping capacity.
Current valid pressure, flow, power, and stability measurements establish the reference result.
Current valid refrigeration and product-protection measurements establish the reference result.
Infinit-Signal preserves original source evidence and classifies time, quality, duplication, replay, and identity before data enters the operating model.
Infinit-Signal creates SSOM-conformant canonical operational records.
MQTT, Sparkplug, OPC UA, SCADA, BMS, MES, historian, platform, API, file, and service-system sources are representative architecture patterns.
The UNS remains the customer's communication and discovery fabric; a topic path remains a source address.
Last Mile does not replace the broker or claim ownership of the customer's namespace.
Singularity is Last Mile's governed operational-memory and OT world-model product implementing SSOM.
SSOM defines an open, vendor-neutral semantic and evidence contract.
Singularity connects canonical identity, topology, Conditions, evidence, time, return measurements, and verified Outcomes across systems.
SSOM conformance and MQTT/Sparkplug compatibility are separate conformance domains.
Cross-site learning requires explicit purpose, consent, minimization, transformation, provenance, retention, and model scope.
SSOM conformance does not grant contribution consent.
Infinit-Flow coordinates one durable case across operators, work systems, providers, approvals, evidence, and return measurements.
Workflow binding is filtered by SSOM class, capability, tenant, site, role, quality, and freshness.
AUTO executes authorized digital steps, ASSIST assembles evidence or recommendations, and HUMAN AUTHORITY retains governed physical and control authority.
Work-system state is contextual evidence only; it cannot set the physical result.
Infinit-Control gives each role a governed view of current state, topology, evidence, ownership, work, authority, return measurements, and Outcomes.
Important measurements show value, engineering unit, reference band, state text and icon, and meaningful trend or freshness.
Stale, quarantined, unresolved, or missing inputs display No valid data and cannot support recovery.
The UNS makes industrial information available; SSOM makes it portable, interpretable, governable, and accountable across systems and time.
Preserve OPC UA source information models and map them through governed profiles.
AAS and other digital-twin models provide asset semantics; Singularity and SSOM provide cross-system operational outcome memory.
Industry 5.0 emphasizes human-centricity, sustainability, and resilience.
Last Mile's operational outcome thread complements broader lifecycle digital threads.
OT security must address physical performance, reliability, and safety requirements.
